AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Disease control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Disease control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Disease control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Disease control.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Producers

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.

10. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Disease control.

12. A — Ice melting to water
